versions.changelog:
Initial release of Airbnb Host Operations skill – manage all core aspects of short-term rental hosting.

- Automates guest messaging, check-in info, and guest review requests.
- Provides pricing optimization alerts, weekly revenue reports, and occupancy suggestions.
- Coordinates cleaning schedules, tracks supplies, and manages maintenance requests.
- Offers listing SEO audits, competitor rate analysis, and amenity suggestions.
- Helps track permit renewals, income/expenses, and tax filing reminders.
- Manages review monitoring, alerting on score drops, and drafts responses to reviews.
